document_title: Complete User Experience Guide - EPUB to Audiobook/Video Converter
description: This document describes exactly what you will see and experience when using this project, from start to finish
what_this_project_does: This project converts your EPUB books (novels, fanfiction, etc.) into professional audiobook videos ready for YouTube upload. It reads the book out loud using AI voices, adds subtitles, creates a thumbnail, and produces a complete video file.

when_you_first_start_the_program.what_you_see: A terminal window opens with a colorful banner showing the project name. The program then runs some automatic checks.

temp_file_cleanup.what_happens: The program looks for old temporary files from previous runs and asks if you want to delete them to save disk space.
temp_file_cleanup.if_old_files_found: You see: 'Found X MB of temp files older than 5 days. Clean up? (y/n)'
temp_file_cleanup.if_you_say_yes: Files are deleted and you see: '✅ Cleaned up X MB'
temp_file_cleanup.if_you_say_no: Files are kept and program continues

checkpoint_detection.what_happens: The program checks if you were in the middle of processing a book when you last closed the program.
checkpoint_detection.if_checkpoint_found: You see a box saying: '📌 CHECKPOINT FOUND - Book: [Title] - Progress: Batch 2/5 - ✅ Completed Chapters: 10'
checkpoint_detection.if_you_say_yes: The program continues exactly where it left off
checkpoint_detection.if_you_say_no: The checkpoint is deleted and you start fresh

system_check.what_happens: The program verifies that FFmpeg and other required tools are installed correctly.
system_check.if_something_missing: You see a warning like: '⚠️ FFmpeg not found. Video creation will not work.'
system_check.if_everything_ok: No message is shown, the program just continues

the_main_menu.what_you_see: After startup checks, you see a menu with numbered options.
menu_options: 2. Continue working on an existing project
3. Manage the processing queue (add multiple books for batch processing)
4. Look up a novel by name
the_main_menu.how_to_choose: Type the number and press Enter

option_1_new_epub.what_you_see: A list of all EPUB files found in the '_NEW_EPUBS_HERE' folder
example_display: 2. Naruto Fanfiction - The Uzumaki Legend.epub (1.8 MB)
3. One Piece SI - Become Pirate King.epub (3.1 MB)
option_1_new_epub.if_no_files_found: You see: '❌ No EPUB files found. Please add files to _NEW_EPUBS_HERE folder.'
option_1_new_epub.what_you_do: Type the number of the book you want to process, or type a full path to an EPUB file anywhere on your computer

validation.what_the_program_does: Checks if the EPUB file is valid and can be read
validation.if_file_corrupted: You see: '❌ Failed to parse EPUB. The file may be corrupted.'
validation.if_file_ok: You see: '✅ EPUB validated successfully. Found 25 chapters.'

duplicate_check.what_the_program_does: Checks if you have processed this exact same EPUB file before
duplicate_check.if_already_processed: You see: '⚠️ This EPUB was already processed on 2025-12-15 (Chapters 1-10). Process again?'

step_1_project_name.what_you_see: The book's title is extracted from the EPUB and shown to you
step_1_project_name.example: '📖 Detected title: The Uzumaki Legend - A Naruto Fanfiction'
step_1_project_name.then_asked: 'Use this title? (y) or enter a custom name:'
step_1_project_name.if_you_type_something: Your custom title is used instead

step_2_checking_for_existing_work.what_happens: Program checks if you previously worked on a book with a similar name

if_found.what_you_see: '🔍 Found existing project: The Uzumaki Legend (processed Ch 1-10 on Dec 15)'
options_given: 3. Re-process the same chapters (replace old files)

step_3_select_tts_engine.what_you_see: A list of available voice engines

what_each_option_means.edge_tts: Uses Microsoft's online AI voices. Sounds natural but needs internet and can fail if servers are busy.
what_each_option_means.piper: Uses AI voice models stored on your computer. Works offline, sounds great, very reliable.
what_each_option_means.pyttsx3: Uses your computer's built-in text-to-speech. Works offline but sounds robotic.
what_each_option_means.chatterbox: Premium AI voices with emotional expression. Needs a good GPU and more processing time.

if_piper.what_you_see: A list of available voice models found in your piper_models folder
if_piper.what_you_do: Type the number of the voice model you want

if_pyttsx3.what_you_see: A list of system voices installed on your computer
if_pyttsx3.example: 1. Microsoft David, 2. Microsoft Zira, 3. Microsoft Mark

step_5_processing_mode.what_you_are_asked: 'Process chapters one at a time or multiple at once?'

sequential.what_it_means: Processes one chapter, waits for it to finish, then processes the next
sequential.when_to_use: If you have limited RAM or want to watch progress
sequential.what_you_see_during: Each chapter displays one by one: 'Processing Chapter 1... ✅ Done (2.3 MB)'

concurrent.what_it_means: Processes multiple chapters at the same time
concurrent.when_to_use: If you have good RAM (8GB+) and want faster processing
concurrent.what_you_see_during: Progress bar showing all chapters being processed simultaneously

step_6_select_chapters.what_you_see: 'This book has 50 chapters. Which chapters do you want to process?'

how_to_answer.all_chapters: Press Enter to process all chapters
how_to_answer.starting_from: Type '11' to process from chapter 11 onwards

if_previously_processed.what_you_see: 'Note: You already processed chapters 1-10. Suggested: start from chapter 11.'
if_previously_processed.if_overlap_detected: '⚠️ This range overlaps with previously processed chapters. Continue anyway?'

what_this_means.batch_of_10: Every 10 chapters become one video. Chapters 1-10 = Video 1, Chapters 11-20 = Video 2
what_this_means.batch_of_all: One very long video with all chapters

step_7_batch_size.recommendation: 10-15 chapters per video is ideal for YouTube

fast.when_to_use: Testing or when you want to see results quickly

high.when_to_use: Final upload when quality matters most
